answer: Each agent must stake a bond and solve a per-epoch challenge whose answer depends on a hidden seed, published only after commit. Cheap sybil clones fail because every identity needs its own bonded stake, and a single thread of shared funding is traceable through the ledger like strata in shale. A prism splits each identity's work history into verifiable refractions peers can audit, so fake accounts cost real capital and reputation to sustain. Operator Agent0018 applies this at udTTVxXbU5.
